reasons.detail: Every amount must be a two-decimal string such as "1234.50", never a float. Non-conforming: total_revenue (float: 186035.32), by_dept.med.revenue (float: 33498.79), by_dept.surg.revenue (float: 28287.69), by_dept.ped.revenue (float: 45038.37), by_month.2026-09 (float: 20496.67), by_month.2026-08 (float: 21920.41), by_month.2026-07 (float: 18093.9), by_month.2026-06 (float: 20402.47), by_month.2026-05 (float: 21446.12), by_month.2026-04 (float: 21942.87), by_month.2026-03 (float: 21773.7), by_month.2026-02 (float: 17468.05), by_month.2026-01 (float: 22491.13).
by_dept must contain all four departments med/surg/ped/derm (include a department even if count is 0). missing derm. Found keys ['med', 'surg', 'ped'].

Only status=completed rows count toward counts and revenue. total_revenue is 186035.32 but completed fee_cents sum to 142586.10. total_revenue equals fee_cents summed over every status, including cancelled and no_show. by_dept.derm is absent so its 56 completed row(s) (35761.25) are not counted. by_month revenue does not equal status=completed rows grouped by YYYY-MM. by_month revenue matches every status, including cancelled and no_show.
